items.title: Keystone Realtors to launch ₹5K cr worth housing properties in MMR by March
items.rss_summary: Realty firm Keystone Realtors Ltd will launch housing properties worth Rs 5,000 crore for sale by March next year in the Mumbai Metropolitan Region (MMR) as it remains bullish on consumer demand, a top company official said. Mumbai-based Keystone Realtors, which is one of the leading real estate developers in the country, sells properties under the 'Rustomjee' brand. In an interview with PTI, the company's Chairman and Managing Director Boman Irani exuded confidence that it would easily achieve the sales bookings or pre-sales target of Rs 5,000 crore for the 2026-17 fiscal. "In the first half of this fiscal, our sales bookings stood at around Rs 2,000 crore, which is 40 per cent of our total guidance for the entire 2026-27. In the real estate sector, sales are generally higher in the second half because of festive demand. So, we are on track to meet the target," he said. During the first six months of this fiscal, the company's sales bookings grew 11 per cent to Rs 2,041 crore from

Company ke CMD Boman Irani ke mutabiq consumer demand mazboot bani hui hai. Financial year ke pehle chhe mahino me company ki sales booking 11 percent badhkar Rs 2,041 crore tak pahunch gayi hai.
